summary: Continued UI styling tweaks in message-parts/messages.css (message-part/message-body spacing, user-role message-meta footer styling) and ran svelte-check and UI hook validation. Began implementing end-to-end session title generation: added session-title.ts, wired protocol request, session-request-handler case, SessionOperations.generateTitle using a title-model catalog, and added generateTitle on WebSocketAgentClient.
decisions: [data-ui='message-part'] uses display:grid with gap:0 so children supply their own leading space, with consecutive tool-calls separated by 2px.
User-role messages use a 2px gap in message-body and treat message-meta as a caption (min-height:0, margin-bottom:-4px) hugging the text.
Session title is requested as a short label, last non-empty line of model output, stripped of leading 'title:' / quotes, capped at 80 chars.
Title generation prefers a configured title-model from the model catalog, falling back to the session's current model.
errors: TypeScript error in session-title.ts: TitleModel interface was not assignable to Model<Api> (missing name, api, baseUrl, reasoning, etc.); resolved by switching from a custom TitleModel type to using Model<Api> returned from session.modelRuntime.getModel().
